column2: What a busy place this is!
column3: 这个地方真热闹！

column2: There is a big castle on the hill.
column3: 山上有一座大城堡。

column2: The restaurant is in that tall building.
column3: 那家饭馆在那栋高楼里。

column2: My arm hurts and I have a toothache.
column3: 我胳膊疼，还牙疼。

column2: I have a sore throat and I cannot speak.
column3: 我喉咙疼，说不出话。

column2: The rooster crows and the sun rises in the east.
column3: 公鸡一叫，太阳就从东边升起来。

column2: The sun will rise soon.
column3: 太阳很快就要升起来了。

column2: In the evening I read page after page.
column3: 晚上我一页接一页地读。

column2: She will leave her shell at home.
column3: 她会把贝壳留在家里。

column2: The cat moves its tail.
column3: 猫动了动它的尾巴。

column2: I want to buy this monkey puppet.
column3: 我想买这个猴子手偶。

column2: Everything is ready for tomorrow.
column3: 明天的一切都准备好了。

column2: Excuse me, where is the hotel?
column3: 打扰一下，请问旅馆在哪儿？

column2: The salesperson shows me a large jacket.
column3: 售货员给我看了一件大夹克。

column2: What size is this jacket?
column3: 这件夹克是什么尺码？

column2: The department store is in front of the station.
column3: 百货商店在车站前面。

column2: The clothing department is on the second floor.
column3: 服装部在二楼。

column2: Which number is my room?
column3: 我的房间是几号？

column2: I am lost, and I cannot find my mailbox.
column3: 我迷路了，也找不到我的信箱。

column2: The total is fifty yuan.
column3: 总共五十元。

column2: This is our last day, so we buy a salad.
column3: 今天是我们的最后一天，所以我们买了一份沙拉。

column2: On Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday I go to school.
column3: 星期一、星期二和星期三我去上学。

column2: On Thursday and Friday we play in the playground.
column3: 星期四和星期五我们在操场上玩。

column2: On Saturday afternoon my cousin comes to my home.
column3: 星期六下午我表姐来我家。

column2: The hippo is dangerous, so do not go near it.
column3: 河马很危险，别靠近它。

column2: Do not push, or you will hit the rock.
column3: 别推，不然你会撞到石头上。

column2: I hurt my leg in the puddle and I shout for help.
column3: 我在水坑里伤了腿，大声呼救。

column2: We dig a hole in the playground.
column3: 我们在操场上挖了一个洞。

column2: The peacock has a colorful tail.
column3: 孔雀的尾巴五颜六色。

column2: A pile of rocks is next to the puddle.
column3: 水坑旁边有一堆石头。

column2: Suddenly we laugh at the hippo.
column3: 我们突然对着河马笑起来。

column2: Give me a piece of paper, please.
column3: 请给我一张纸。

column2: Do you have any more paper?
column3: 你还有纸吗？

column2: Next, we go home.
column3: 然后我们就回家了。

column2: The wind blows and the waves are big.
column3: 风刮起来，浪很大。

column2: A storm is coming, and we can see lightning.
column3: 暴风雨要来了，我们能看见闪电。

column2: During the storm, we stay in a cave.
column3: 暴风雨期间，我们待在洞里。

column2: A helicopter flies over the land.
column3: 一架直升机飞过陆地。

column2: The axis of the Earth goes around the sun.
column3: 地球的轴绕着太阳转。

column2: We walk along the river and face the sea.
column3: 我们沿着河走，面朝大海。

column2: Someday I want to fly in a helicopter.
column3: 将来某一天，我想坐一次直升机。

column2: Many adults have no time for a nap at noon.
column3: 许多成年人中午都没时间小睡一会儿。

column2: Most birds can fly, for example the swallow.
column3: 大多数鸟都会飞，比如燕子。

column2: The old dog walks slowly and keeps its own bone.
column3: 老狗慢慢走着，守着自己的骨头。

column2: I have nothing to write, only one word.
column3: 我没东西可写，只有一个词。

column2: This is the most important part of the book.
column3: 这是书里最重要的一部分。

column2: Can I ask you some questions?
column3: 我可以问你几个问题吗？

column2: Life is a wonderful thing.
column3: 生命是美好的事物。

column2: He sends an SOS during the storm.
column3: 他在暴风雨中发出了求救信号。

column2: There is a small house among the trees.
column3: 树林中间有一间小房子。

column2: It is safe to stay at home in a storm.
column3: 暴风雨天待在家里是安全的。
